trial_court: Senior Civil Judge, Ramdurg, Matrimonial Case No.17/2015
case_name: Shri. Basavaraddi Devaraddi vs Smt. Padmavati W/O Basavaraddi

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Shri. Basavaraddi Devaraddi, husband, retired government servant
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Padmavati W/O Basavaraddi, wife, household wife

facts_of_case: The parties were married in 1985 and the husband filed a petition for divorce seeking dissolution of their marriage. The trial court granted judicial separation instead of divorce.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes through a compromise petition.
legal_principles.held: The parties are to bear their own costs. Office is to draw a decree accordingly.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — Order XXIII Rule 3

legal_principles.principle: A party's consent to a settlement can be inferred from their actions.
legal_principles.held: The parties have decided to go for divorce as they are already living separately for more than 25 years, on the following terms;

outcome.final_order: The appeal was allowed and the decree of divorce was granted to dissolve the marriage.
